title: Lactic acid is NOT why your muscles burn 🔥
caption: Lactate is fuel: your heart, brain and liver burn it, and it's mostly cleared within about an hour. The burn is acid from hydrogen ions. Did your coach ever blame lactic acid? 👇
first_comment: Who still blames lactic acid for leg-day pain? Tag them 😅
sources: Brooks GA. The Science and Translation of Lactate Shuttle Theory. Cell Metab 2018
Brooks quoted in NYT 2006 'Lactic Acid Is Not Muscles' Foe, It's Fuel'; lactate used by heart, brain, liver
Cheung K et al. DOMS: treatment strategies and performance factors. Sports Med 2003 (soreness peaks 24-72 h; lactate clears within about an hour)
Robergs et al. 2004 and later reviews: the burn/acidosis is linked to hydrogen ions, not lactate
